rows.description: Two screens: xp on the left, tiling on the right (empty)
rows.expected: xp desktop with taskbar; tiling desktop empty
The Start menu opens on the xp screen
A text editor opens on the xp screen

rows.description: DRAG 1: pull the title bar of the editor window from xp to the tiling screen
rows.expected: the editor window leaves xp and tiles in the tiling screen (full height)

rows.description: The person types a line in the editor on its new screen
rows.expected: The text appears in the editor on the tiling screen

rows.description: DRAG 2: Super+drag the editor window from tiling to the construct screen
rows.expected: the editor window leaves tiling and becomes a pane in the construct space

rows.description: DRAG 3: Super+drag the the editor window pane from construct to the xp screen
rows.expected: the editor window leaves the construct and shows in xp with a title bar and a task button

rows.description: DRAG 4: pull the title bar of the editor window from xp to the mc screen
rows.expected: the editor window becomes the window of an mc scene

rows.description: DRAG 5: Super+drag the editor window out of mc to the xp screen
rows.expected: the editor window leaves mc and shows in xp

rows.description: GIVE BY KEY: Super+Alt+1 (give the focused window to tiling)
rows.expected: the editor window goes to tiling and fills its screen

rows.description: GIVE BY KEY: Super+Alt+2 (give the focused window to xp)
rows.expected: the editor window goes back to xp
